item.title: Which Instruction File Wins: A Three-Letter Experiment, Silent Failures, and a Single Source of Truth
item.description: A repo holds AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, skills and runtime configuration all at once, and there is no universal answer to which one wins a conflict. The original article's three-letter experiment takes ten minutes and no permissions: write ALPHA, BRAVO and CHARLIE into three sources, then ask the agent for a status word. The result is decided per harness and per version, silently. The fix is canonical plus references: declare one source of truth, turn everything else into pointers. Reader evidence included; no data invented.
